entries.4d7735e4b99d793f: A business that imports architectural finishing materials, centered on tiles and stone, used for floors and walls of stores, commercial facilities, houses and condominiums, co-developed with the world's top manufacturers, and sells them directly to domestic building owners, builders, construction companies and others; it is the core of the Group.
entries.7f0d18e2bb9c0d79: A business that imports architectural finishing materials, centered on tiles and stone, used for floors and walls of stores, commercial facilities, houses and condominiums, co-developed with the world's top manufacturers, and sells them directly to domestic building owners, builders, construction companies and others; it is the core of the Group. It also imports and sells plumbing products such as faucets and housing equipment such as system kitchens in the same way, and undertakes construction work that uses these products as materials. Selling prices are clearly stated in catalogs and on the website and are the same regardless of the purchaser's attributes. Showrooms are located in five places: Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka and Okinawa. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥16,885 million (down 8.2% from the previous fiscal year) and operating profit was ¥2,456 million (down 24.2% from the previous fiscal year), accounting for almost all of consolidated revenue of ¥17,036 million. The securities report cites persistently high purchasing costs and, owing to a shortage of skilled workers at construction sites, construction delays and postponed starts on some large projects as the reasons.

entries.d3fb12e9d1948726: A business in which the subsidiary ADVAN Kanri Service Co., Ltd. leases the head office building, the logistics center and company housing to the Company and ADVAN Logistics Co., Ltd. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue (including inter-segment internal revenue) was ¥2,592 million (up 5.0% from the previous year) and operating profit was ¥1,268 million (down 4.3% from the previous year). Most of the revenue comes from leasing within the group (inter-segment internal revenue); revenue from external customers is ¥150 million.
entries.db036d4735d463e1: A logistics management business in which the subsidiary ADVAN Logistics Co., Ltd. handles the receiving and shipping of the Company's products. The securities report states that the reportable segment "Other" consists of this logistics management business. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue (including inter-segment internal revenue) was ¥1,089 million (down 28.0% from the previous year) and operating profit was ¥378 million (down 11.9% from the previous year). There is no revenue from external customers; all of the revenue is inter-segment internal revenue.
